question: In a population we want to determine the prevalence of pediculosis in children under 12 years of age. To do this, the population is divided into neighborhoods and in each of them a random sample is taken whose ideal size has been previously determined. The type of sampling used was:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Population divided into neighborhoods" -> "Random sample taken in each neighborhood" -> "Ideal sample size determined" -> "Simple random sampling used" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Population divided into neighborhoods" -> "Random sample taken in each neighborhood" -> "Ideal sample size determined" -> "Stratified random sampling used" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Population divided into neighborhoods" -> "Random sample taken in each neighborhood" -> "Ideal sample size determined" -> "Random sampling by conglomerates used" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Population divided into neighborhoods" -> "Random sample taken in each neighborhood" -> "Ideal sample size determined" -> "Systematic sampling used" -> 85%
analysis: Stratified random sampling was used in this scenario where the population was divided into neighborhoods and a random sample was taken from each neighborhood. This method allows for more accurate estimation of prevalence within specific subgroups.
